_purpose: Forward-compatible placeholders for the wider Hugging Face surface beyond hf_hub. Each is a named OpKind reservation; when the corresponding substrate lands we activate the op without renaming. Cards that reference these by id keep working across the activation switch.
_anchor: hf_hub (core/lib/hf_hub.py) is the live umbrella; the entries below are the long-tail HF ecosystem.

operations.summary: Local transformers pipeline call — when local GPU is available, run inference through `transformers.pipeline(task, model=...)` instead of routing to cloud providers.
operations.links_to_substrate: task_queue.GPU pool; complements hf_hub.inference (cloud) with on-device path

operations.summary: Local diffusers run for image/video/audio generation. Wraps StableDiffusionPipeline / FluxPipeline / HunyuanVideoPipeline. Mounts via model_installer's existing flux_2_klein lora.
operations.links_to_substrate: task_queue.GPU pool + lora_swap (peft); studio_runtime._dispatch_diffusers wires here when activated

operations.summary: Hot-swap a LoRA / adapter onto an already-loaded base model. Routes through peft for parameter-efficient inference deltas without reloading 9B weights.
operations.examples: FLUX.2-klein-9B base + flux_2_klein_face_swap LoRA (already on disk)

operations.summary: Multi-GPU / FSDP / DeepSpeed launch wrapper. When a card pass needs distributed compute across our 2× RTX 3090 Ti, route through accelerate.
operations.links_to_substrate: task_queue.GPU pool; gpu_router selects which device + accelerate config

operations.summary: Apply optimum's quantization / pruning / distillation to a base model on-disk; produces a smaller variant in /home/tom/models/optimum/.
operations.links_to_substrate: model_installer (writes the quantized variant); ops_dag (cheap tier)

operations.summary: Rust-side inference via candle — when the gently/ Rust chain needs ML inference and we don't want to cross the Python boundary, route through candle's GGUF / safetensors backends. Pairs with telos-ml-tools MCP on the gently side.
operations.links_to_substrate: gently chain side; this entry exists for cross-half awareness via NOTES-FOR-INFERANCE.md

operations.summary: Load a compute kernel from kernels-community via the kernels Python lib. For when a card pass needs a specific CUDA op not in upstream torch.

lerobot end-to-end learning pipeline for robotics policies. Cross-pollinates with spatial_anchor: the same coord_graph that anchors a real room can serve as the manipulation frame for a policy. Future humanoid-avatar control loop.

Mount a HF model/dataset bucket as a local filesystem via hf-mount (Rust). No download — direct read from S3-style backing. Lets ComfyUI / diffusers / model_installer treat the entire Hub as if it were /mnt/hf/.
operations.links_to_substrate: model_installer (extends model_path resolution to /mnt/hf/...); task_queue.CLOUD (zero-copy paths)

operations.summary: Stream HF datasets via the hf_hub.stream_dataset() helper. Wraps the datasets-server rows API so training/eval loops can iterate without parquet download.
operations.links_to_substrate: datasets_index (extends local dataset catalog to cloud); workflow_card data-feed passes

operations.summary: TRL — train transformer language models with reinforcement learning. When we want to fine-tune a router/classifier on our own crystal-chain feedback loop, route through trl. Pairs with codie-oracle on the gently side.
operations.links_to_substrate: moe_router (training data via crystal chain); dialectic_walker (IS-NOT signal as reward)

operations.summary: Image encoder/backbone via pytorch-image-models (timm). Drop-in for the 'embed an image' lane that we currently lack — pairs the SVG vector embedder with a pixel embedder for the same hypersphere.
operations.links_to_substrate: svg_vector_embed (joins the same 64-d L2-normalized space); moe_router 6th retrieval axis

operations.summary: Local voice agent loop — STT → LLM → TTS via the speech-to-speech repo. Pairs with our existing vocal_separator + wardrobe_studio audio paths.
